title: Initial registration accepted by the network

entities.name: Initial registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure where UE initiates registration with the network and receives REGISTRATION ACCEPT message upon acceptance.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate registration procedure.

entities.name: REGISTRATION ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by AMF to UE when initial registration request is accepted.

entities.name: REGISTRATION COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent by UE to AMF to acknowledge reception of certain IEs in REGISTRATION ACCEPT.

entities.name: 5GMM capability
entities.description: IE indicating UE's 5GMM capabilities, stored by AMF from REGISTRATION REQUEST.

entities.name: TAI list
entities.description: IE containing tracking area identities assigned as registration area, included in REGISTRATION ACCEPT.

entities.name: 5G-GUTI
entities.description: Globally Unique Temporary Identifier assigned to UE during registration.

entities.name: Allowed NSSAI
entities.description: IE containing network slice selection assistance information allowed for UE.

entities.name: Rejected NSSAI
entities.description: IE containing S-NSSAIs that are rejected by the network.

entities.name: 5GS registration result
entities.description: IE indicating registration result, including access type and NSSAA indicators.

entities.name: T3550
entities.description: Timer started by AMF when certain IEs are included in REGISTRATION ACCEPT, stopped upon REGISTRATION COMPLETE.

entities.name: 5GMM-COMMON-PROCEDURE-INITIATED
entities.description: State entered by AMF when timer T3550 is started during registration procedure.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: State entered by UE upon receipt of REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.

entities.name: Emergency registration condition
entities.description: Condition where 5GS registration type IE is set to emergency registration, affecting restriction checks.

entities.name: Store UE capabilities
entities.description: AMF stores UE capabilities (5GMM capability, S1 UE network capability, UE security capability) from REGISTRATION REQUEST.

relations.description: Initial registration procedure begins with UE sending REGISTRATION REQUEST.
AMF sends REGISTRATION ACCEPT if initial registration request is accepted.
REGISTRATION ACCEPT contains TAI list assigned as registration area.
REGISTRATION ACCEPT may contain a new 5G-GUTI assigned to UE.
REGISTRATION ACCEPT contains allowed NSSAI if UE included requested NSSAI and AMF allows it.
REGISTRATION ACCEPT may contain rejected NSSAI with S-NSSAIs not allowed by network.
REGISTRATION ACCEPT contains 5GS registration result IE indicating access type and NSSAA indicators.
REGISTRATION REQUEST contains 5GMM capability IE indicating UE capabilities.
During initial registration, AMF stores UE capabilities from REGISTRATION REQUEST.
Emergency registration condition affects how AMF processes REGISTRATION REQUEST (e.g., no restriction checks).
AMF starts timer T3550 when certain IEs (e.g., 5G-GUTI, SOR transparent container) are included in REGISTRATION ACCEPT.
AMF stops timer T3550 upon receiving REGISTRATION COMPLETE message.
When timer T3550 is started, AMF enters state 5GMM-COMMON-PROCEDURE-INITIATED.
UE enters state 5GMM-REGISTERED upon receipt of REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.
AMF changes to state 5GMM-REGISTERED upon receiving REGISTRATION COMPLETE message.
